title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（出村公成研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Demura Kosei)
educationalGoal:
(1) Acquire the ability to find and solve problems to research, develop, design, and create new robotic systems, using the basic knowledge and skills you learned in other Department of Robotics courses.
(2) Learn what technologies are required to solve problems.
(3) Learn about the importance of collaboration with society (particularly local communities).
advice:
This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Robotics. It is a two-semester course. For the realization of the educational objectives in the Department of Robotics, this course focuses on the following topics:
(1) Students will acquire the ability to create new robotic systems integrated mechanics, measurement and control engineering, electronics, and programming techniques.
(2) Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to propose optimal solutions through design projects.

Students should reconfirm their project theme, which has been determined in a preparatory seminar with the supervisors of the individual laboratories.
requiredKnowledge:
Have the skills and knowledge required for carrying out a project at each laboratory.
Obtain a license for using machine tools at YUMEKOBO.

activityGoals.body: Advance your project in according to the engineering design process.
Compile the results correctly into a report and discuss the content through presentations.
Act independently to solve the issues presented separately.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Robotics. It is a two-semester course. For the realization of the educational objectives in the Department of Robotics, this course focuses on the following topics:
(1) Students will acquire the ability to create new robotic systems integrated mechanics, measurement and control engineering, electronics, and programming techniques.
(2) Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to propose optimal solutions through design projects.

Students should reconfirm their project theme, which has been determined in a preparatory seminar with the supervisors of the individual laboratories.
